Rina (Docs): quick PR for slab-labels in metering hub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4891. TL;DR: renames meter label from `tier` -> `slab`, adds a consumption heatmap panel, and includes node/python SDK snippets. need: billing to confirm label semantics, eng to vet the PromQL. aiming to merge tomorrow.

Jasper (Billing): will check semantics. backend currently emits slab values: standard|gold|enterprise and a legacy value `legacy`. docs should explain the mapping and any billing transition notes.

Hanna (Eng): looked at the dashboard panels. two quick notes: 1) are we displaying p50 or p95? if p95, use `histogram_quantile(0.95, ...)`. 2) to handle legacy labels we should show an example with `label_replace` to normalize values in the query rather than changing all metrics upstream.

Rina (Docs): good points. I'll add both quantile variants. Proposed PromQL for slab p95 token latency: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, slab))`

Jasper (Billing): for migration guidance, recommend a small rewrite for Dedicated customers at the proxy level so legacy customers keep working. i'll paste an nginx snippet later. also suggest a tiny table mapping old->new slab semantics and whether cost tiers change.

Rina (Docs): added the migration note and a short table mapping legacy -> standard, plus a one-line about how slab changes may affect per-token pricing. also added Node and Python SDK examples showing the usage header `x-redwood-slab: gold`.

Hanna (Eng): nit: node example used `await client.createUsage(...)` but the SDK method is `reportUsage`. updated and pushed. also removed an extra trailing comma from the JSON example in the panel docs.

dash-bot: preview build #4891: https://deploy-preview-4891--docs.redwood.com :white_check_mark:

Jasper (Billing): LGTM from billing once the legacy mapping is explicit in the migration section. can we include a one-liner about how to roll customers between slabs without immediate billing impact?

Rina (Docs): added a short paragraph recommending a 2-week overlap window and a notice to customers. merged into staging; will hold final merge until @Maria finishes a docs-only pass.

Maria (Docs): doing a tone + accessibility pass now; will flag any UI wording nits.

Rina (Docs): thanks all 60A
